cards.title: One scope, everywhere
items: migration.yaml is the only place scope/path-rules/principals are typed
dbxmig handoff projects it into every accelerator's own config format
A scope change means editing one file, not three

cards.title: In practice, these run in parallel
items: databricks-replicator (tables) and workspace-migration (functions, models, filters) don't depend on each other -- both start as soon as handoff finishes
The Terraform Exporter (jobs) runs independently of both
Drawn in sequence here for readability; reconciliation is the real join point

cards.title: Reconciliation is the one gate
items: A dirty reconcile blocks cutover, not just a warning
See validation/data-reconciliation for the exact checks
